meta.name: hyperframes-cli
meta.description: Use the HyperFrames CLI development loop: init, add, catalog, capture, lint, check, snapshot, compare, grade-compare, preview, play, present, beats, keyframes, single or batch render, publish, cloud, cloudrun, feedback, lambda, doctor, browser, info, upgrade, skills, compositions, docs, benchmark, telemetry, transcribe, auth, tts, and remove-background. Also use when diagnosing build or render failures. validate, inspect, and layout are deprecated aliases; use check. Covers local, HeyGen-hosted cloud, AWS Lambda, and Google Cloud Run rendering.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用命令行指令编排视频内容,自动完成渲染与发布
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望用脚本化方式制作和渲染视频,不想依赖图形界面。
copy.tagline_en: Create and render videos via command line, from keyframes to cloud targets.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you prefer scripted video work over manual editing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 HyperFrames 的命令行工具搭建视频项目、查找可复用动画、检查错误、预览并渲染；也能用它诊断构建或渲染失败。渲染支持本地、HeyGen 云端、AWS Lambda 与 Google Cloud Run。
howto.when: 当用户要求执行 HyperFrames 开发流程(初始化、添加动画、渲染等)，或要求诊断构建/渲染失败时，会触发此技能。

say.text: 用 HyperFrames 初始化一个叫 demo 的项目
say.note: 会执行 npx hyperframes init demo

say.text: 在动画目录里找一个逐行展示标题的效果并加入项目
say.note: 会检索目录并 add 对应项

say.text: 跑最终检查，通过后等我确认再渲染
say.note: 先 check 再 preview 等待审批

howto.what_en: Claude can use the HyperFrames CLI to scaffold a project, search for reusable animations, lint, check, preview and render videos, and diagnose build/render failures. Covers local, HeyGen cloud, AWS Lambda and Google Cloud Run rendering.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to run the HyperFrames CLI loop (such as init, add, or render) or to diagnose a build/render failure.

say_en.text: Initialize a HyperFrames project named demo
Find a headline reveal effect in the catalog and add it to the project
say_en.note: Searches the catalog and adds the item

say_en.text: Run the final check, then wait for my approval to render
say_en.note: Runs check and waits before rendering
